fetch_method: curl -L (Chrome UA, Accept-Language en-US) GET of the issuer's own 'Distributions' download link (href found in the product page's Distributions section). Server answered http=200 content_type=text/csv;charset=UTF-8 size=1441768 but the body is the product-page HTML; the distribution table was read from the raw server-rendered JSON block "performance.distributions.table" inside that HTML (bracket-matched, json.loads, no regex on numbers).
csv_export_result: HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/csv but body was the product-page HTML (same with siteEntryPassthrough=true, Referer/Accept/X-Requested-With headers, no-UA, and via WebFetch); the embedded JSON in that HTML is the same table the page renders, so it was parsed instead
amount_definition: per-share cash total = totalDistribution column (issuer-reported) = incomeAmount + shortTermCapitalGain + longTermCapitalGain + returnOnCapital; all in USD
parsing_notes: totalDistribution differs from component sum on 3 rows (max diff 0.000045); used totalDistribution as reported by issuer
coverage_note: EEM inception 2003-04-07; first distribution ex-date in issuer table is 2003-12-22; cutoff applied ex_date <= 2026-07-17

secondary_confirmation.note: canonical product page fetched separately (http 200, 1687754 bytes); carries the same table HTML-entity-encoded ("), not parsed. An earlier independent fetch of the export URL (probe3.bin, sha256 5578d26b...) parsed to a byte-identical CSV.

excluded: none: no stock splits, no reinvested/undistributed capital gains rows in the issuer table; all shortTermCapitalGain/longTermCapitalGain/returnOnCapital values are 0.0 for every row, so every amount is ordinary income cash
